data.name: Voxel Wild
data.detailed_description:
Voxel Wild is a third-person open-world survival crafting action RPG built around exploration, destruction, building, and personal expression. Venture into procedurally generated lands, gather resources from a destructible voxel world, build a place to call home, and customize weapons and armor voxel by voxel. Hunt, cook, trade, and challenge powerful enemies alone or with friends in online co-op.

EXPLORE A CHANGING VOXEL WORLD

Travel across procedurally generated wilderness shaped by changing weather and a day-and-night cycle. Discover villages, meet wandering adventurers, follow rumors, and prepare for the dangers waiting beyond the safety of your campfire.

BREAK, GATHER, AND BUILD

Fell trees, mine stone, reshape the terrain, and recover resources from the world around you. Turn what you gather into tools, crafting stations, defenses, and a home built piece by piece.

MAKE YOUR EQUIPMENT TRULY YOURS

Craft weapons and armor, then customize their shape, materials, and colors voxel by voxel. Create equipment that reflects your style while adjusting its weight, damage, defense, and other combat properties.

FIGHT WITH WEIGHT AND TIMING

Master swords, maces, bows, shields, dodges, and heavy attacks. Break an enemy's poise to create an opening, hunt wild animals, battle hostile creatures, and face towering bosses such as the Cyclops.

GROW THROUGH DISCOVERY

Cook and taste new meals to earn small permanent improvements. Discover rare artifacts, bind their power to your character, and become stronger through exploration rather than a traditional character level.

PLAY ALONE OR TOGETHER

Experience the world in single-player or invite friends through online co-op. Explore, gather, build, customize equipment, and confront powerful enemies together.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Broadband internet connection required for online co-op.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 SUPER 6 GB or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT 6 GB
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Broadband internet connection required for online co-op.
